admission.justification: Retirement and continued support were weighed; the choice keeps the catalog checks and template maintained until numbers say otherwise.

alternatives.option: Keep supporting the entity catalog: its instructions and template move into l-01 as today's practice, written to match the catalog checks, with no deprecation markers.
alternatives.reason: The machinery still works and Curators maintain it; its usefulness is to be judged later from numbers.

alternatives.option: Retire the entity catalog with c-05.
alternatives.reason: Retiring working machinery without evidence of its use was premature.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Measured use shows Curators no longer maintain or read the catalog.

consequences: l-01 holds the catalog template and a Curator detail section that match the catalog alignment check.
context: With c-05 removed, the entity catalog's workflow and template had to move into l-01 or be retired. An earlier ruling had leaned towards retiring it.
decider: The developer (D693 Q1, superseding the entity-catalog part of D691); MIK-R84 v10 behaviour 7.
